title: Invite team member by email
behavior: A pending invitation is recorded without creating a member session
constraints: Use a synthetic email in demos
acceptance: Invitation is pending and associated with the workspace

title: Assign role to invited member
behavior: Selected role is attached to the pending invitation
acceptance: Assigned role is visible before sending

title: Accept invitation
behavior: Person can join the specified workspace
acceptance: Valid invitation is accepted only once

title: Revoke pending invitation
behavior: Invitation can no longer be used

title: Handle invitation errors
trigger: An invitation is expired or invalid
behavior: An actionable error is shown without revealing account existence
acceptance: Invalid invitation shows safe recovery guidance
